name: ITW Appliance Components
old_description: We are a global industrial company that delivers innovative, customer-driven solutions through its engineering expertise and commitment to operational excellence.
about:
ITW Appliance Components operates from New Berlin, Wisconsin, as part of the global ITW enterprise. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure on its public site, and no individual founders are named.

The business manufactures components for dishwashers and washing machines. Its product lines include sensors for water management, closures such as door locks and latches, actuators, and motion systems. The site describes a global footprint with offices worldwide, but provides no facility size, headcount, annual volume, or part-number count.

Customers are appliance original-equipment manufacturers. The company references "trusted relationships with leading OEMs" and focuses on the home-appliance sector, specifically dishwashers and washing machines. No other end markets or named customers are listed.

ITW Appliance Components says it differentiates through engineering expertise, operational excellence, and a combination of global scale with local insight. It emphasizes sustainability, smart design, and energy-efficient solutions tailored to OEM goals.
